title: The Microstructures, Mechanical Properties, and Deformation Mechanism of B2-Hardened NbTiAlZr-Based Refractory High-Entropy Alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum melting in a Ti-gettered argon atmosphere. Intermediate alloys were prepared separately, blended, and remelted six times.
